content.user_title: Plan Automotive Email Campaigns and Follow-Up
content.value_statement: Automotive email campaigns can become inaccurate when inventory, appointments, and marketing permissions change. This skill guides campaign drafts and follow-up plans using verified business data.
actual_capabilities: Draft subject lines, preheaders, concise email bodies, and a primary call to action for automotive campaigns.
Plan inventory-page and service-page lead capture while excluding financing applications and identity documents.
Define segments by shopper stage, dealership, vehicle interest, requested next step, and marketing eligibility.
Specify follow-up entry events, authoritative data, delays, branches, exits, re-entry, deduplication, and uncertain-send handling.
Review sold inventory, appointment changes, missing CRM updates, consent exclusions, and overlapping staff outreach before launch.
Define inquiry, test-drive, service-booking, and sales measurements with explicit denominators and attribution limits.
limitations: Does not supply inventory, appointment, or purchase data; campaign decisions require current authoritative sources.
Does not provide guaranteed CRM integrations or verified platform features; implementation requires current documentation and access.
Does not authorize sending, scheduling, personal-data uploads, or live account changes through a drafting request.
Does not determine creditworthiness, promise financing approval, certify legal compliance, or replace qualified review.

use_cases.title: Prepare Dealership Campaign Copy
use_cases.description: Draft model education or test-drive invitations using verified availability, approved claims, and an eligible audience.

use_cases.title: Plan Service Follow-Up
use_cases.description: Design service reminders from verified records or documented intervals while keeping service interests separate from vehicle-sales consent.

use_cases.title: Review CRM Journey Logic
use_cases.description: Check entry conditions, appointment branches, consent rechecks, duplicate events, and uncertain-send reconciliation before implementation.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Test-Drive Invitation
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a test-drive email for [model] at [dealership] using [verified facts]. Include a subject, preheader, body, and one CTA. Mark unknown details with placeholders.

prompt_templates.title: Define an Eligible Audience
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan segments for [campaign] using [available fields]. Separate vehicle interest, dealership, shopper stage, and consent. Identify exclusions and missing facts that block launch.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: prepare audience logic for review.

prompt_templates.title: Specify an Inquiry Journey
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a follow-up journey for [inquiry type] in [platform]. Define data authorities, entry, delays, appointment branches, consent rechecks, exits, re-entry, and staff overlap. Do not execute.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Queued Campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [journey specification] against [inventory, appointment, consent, and event data]. Test sold units, opt-outs, duplicate events, cancellations, and uncertain sends. Return prioritized blockers, reconciliation steps, measurement denominators, and the next authorized action.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: review launch readiness and failure handling.

output_examples.input: A used vehicle sold while 80 subscribers remained queued for follow-up. The CRM also contains 12 people without marketing permission. Draft next steps only.
output: Hold stale messages promoting the sold vehicle.
Exclude the 12 contacts without marketing permission; do not assume whether they overlap the queued audience.
Verify alternative inventory and each recipient's consent scope before drafting replacement offers.
No messages sent and no live records changed.

output_examples.input: Draft a test-drive invitation for an availability-confirmed model at Northside Motors. The booking URL and appointment slots are not supplied.
output: Preheader: Request a test drive at your preferred dealership.
Body: Interested in [model]? Request a test drive at Northside Motors. The team will confirm available appointment times.
Launch blocker: Verify the booking destination and current appointment availability before sending.

output_examples.input: An inquiry follow-up timed out during sending. The delivery outcome is unknown. What should the journey specification require?
output: Hold the affected send while reconciling provider status and logs.
Preserve campaign and request identifiers; use provider-supported idempotency.
Deduplicate repeated business events even when retries use different delivery identifiers.
Keep the action on hold if its outcome remains uncertain.

best_practices: Provide verified inventory, appointment sources, location, consent scope, and approved offer terms before requesting campaign copy.
Recheck audience eligibility and business data before delayed sends; treat missing permission and stale availability as launch blockers.
Request drafts or specifications first, then obtain explicit authorization before any live action.
anti_patterns: Treating browsing behavior, location, or service history as proof of creditworthiness or vehicle-sales marketing consent.
Promoting sold inventory, inventing financing terms, or presenting unverified appointment availability as confirmed.
Automatically retrying uncertain sends or treating a draft request as permission to upload contacts and launch campaigns.

faq.question: Does this skill send email campaigns?
faq.answer: It provides drafting and planning guidance. Sending, scheduling, uploading personal data, and changing live systems require applicable authorization.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The listing supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Platform access and integrations must be established separately.

faq.question: Does it require Poptin?
faq.answer: No. It preserves the selected platform and considers Poptin only for a relevant, verified capture gap.

faq.question: Can it write financing offers?
faq.answer: Financing copy requires approved source material and qualified review. The skill prohibits invented payment terms and approval promises.

faq.question: What data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide relevant location, current inventory or service records, appointment authority, marketing permissions, platform details, and approved campaign facts.

faq.question: Can I test it without account access?
faq.answer: Yes. The included offline scenario tests sold-inventory handling and consent exclusions without sending messages or changing records.
